visualCharacteristics: Three columns on desktop: intro text with a product logo, then two tall photos (electrician, technician). Stacks to one column on mobile.
contentPattern: One row. Cell 1: paragraph(s) + optional logo image. Cells 2..n: one photo each.
usage: Seguro Protege Casa intro under 'Protecao para sua casa, sossego para voce.' (text + Protege Casa logo | electrician photo | technician photo).
reuseGuidance: Use for an intro paragraph paired with one or more photos. Image-only cells become cover photos; an image alone in a paragraph inside the text cell is treated as a logo. Empty cells are dropped.
